questions.question: When Pilate offered to free one prisoner at Passover, which man did the people shout for instead of Jesus?
When Jesus stood before Pilate, what reason did the Jews give for saying He must die by their law?

answers.text: He declared Himself the Son of God
He healed people on the Sabbath

questions.question: Pilate asked the chief priests if he should crucify their King. What did the chief priests answer?

answers.text: We have no king but Caesar
Our only King is the Lord

questions.question: After the crowds demanded it, Pilate set Jesus free instead of sending Him to be crucified. True or false?
